messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired - INC-2026. p99 latency spike in prod-us-west for /v1/generate. Current p99 = 1.9s (baseline ~0.6s). Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-2026
kmurphy: acked. I'm on it.
ops-bot: Related metric: redwood_inference_latency_p99{env=\"prod\",region=\"us-west\"} spiked at 17:02 UTC, +220%
elaine: noticed customer tickets? any errors or 5xx?
sam: no increase in 5xx, just tail latency. Traces show large tokenization timeouts on sidecar-host-12.
kmurphy: running quick query to confirm, will try to scale sidecars.
kmurphy: `kubectl get pods -l app=tokenizer -n prod --field-selector=status.phase=Running` -> a few pods in CrashLoopBackOff, memory OOM spikes on host-12
nora: that host is on a legacy instance type (small mem). Was part of the rolling upgrade last night.
elaine: could be memory pressure + large batch request sizes. Any big batch jobs around 17:00?
sam: yes, internal eval job #eval-881 started at 16:58 with large batch=2048. It targeted prod-us-west by mistake.
kmurphy: scaling tokenizer deployment (+3 replicas) and cordoning host-12. Executing drain now.
kmurphy: `kubectl cordon host-12 && kubectl drain host-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
jordan: on-call takeover scheduled in 20m, keep me posted for handoff.
kmurphy: temporary mitigation: scaled down eval-881 to batch=128 and paused new eval tasks to prod region. Also bumped tokenizer CPU/memory limits.
sam: applying route fallback for critical customer routes to smaller model variant (model-small) to reduce tail. Patch pushed to routing-config.
elaine: good - any user-visible impact? notify support?
nora: support: flagged as potential slowdown for a small % of requests, no error spike. Create high-priority note in status page?
kmurphy: posting heads-up to #support and #incident-bridge now. :speech_balloon:
incident-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged by kmurphy at 17:07 UTC
sam: after scaling and pausing eval, p99 dropped to ~0.75s at 17:18 UTC. Still above baseline but much improved.
kmurphy: leaving autoscaler at higher min replicas for next 30m and monitoring.
jordan: taking over active incident at 17:22 UTC for rotation handoff. I'll monitor while kmurphy steps off.
elaine: action items: (1) prevent eval jobs from hitting prod (add region tag + guard), (2) enforce batch size cap for evals, (3) audit legacy hosts in us-west pool.
kmurphy: agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket and assign to infra.
incident-bot: Alert INC-2026 resolved - p99 back within acceptable threshold at 17:40 UTC.
jordan: thanks all. I'll keep an eye for another 30m then close the loop. :thumbsup:
nora: filing customer-facing summary for support: small latency degradation for a subset of requests between 17:00-17:20 UTC, mitigated, no errors observed.
kmurphy: switching to monitoring-only, handing off to jordan.
jordan: acknowledged handoff. closing thread in 30m if stable.
